noise_multiplier: z = requested coordinate standard deviation / unchanged clipping bound C
scope: honest clients only; adversaries retain their declared behavior
zero_noise_reference: the three completed sigma=0 cells in configs/transfer_study.json; no additional training
extensions: CGSV and RFFL are rescored offline on the identical cached updates with their frozen pilot parameters
adjacency: replacement of one honest client's complete data, conditional on fixed public identities, partition and record counts
sensitivity: 2C; independently released client updates; no sampling amplification
interpretation: The implied epsilon values are large. This comparison measures rewards for noisy honest clients, without claiming a strong privacy guarantee.
failure_policy: retain every declared cell and numerical failure; no retuning or survivor-only full-horizon intervals
